name: pickup_remove_other_spawns_same_opt_entry
description: Pickup::RemoveOtherSpawnsWithSameOptEntry removes primary spawn-list entries whose pickup type has the requested opt entry, except for the currently kept pickup object.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e2f0 validates the g_PickupSpawnList_Primary walk, saved-next iteration before removal, keep-pickup-object skip, pickupType->optEntry comparison, and PickupSpawnList::RemoveAndFreeNode removal from the primary list.
